150.description: These tokens represent lowercase vowels and vowel combinations featuring various diacritics and phonetic variants across different languages.

146.description: This vector activates strongly on the letter sequence "in" across various languages and writing systems.

96.description: This vector represents fragments of common Thai words and prefixes, most notably the nominalizer "ความ" (khwam).

77.description: This vector represents the Thai consonant 'ม' (Mo Ma) combined with various vowels and preceding words.

39.description: This feature vector activates strongly on Thai vowel and tone mark characters, along with occasional unrelated ASCII artifacts.

103.description: This feature vector activates strongly on multilingual proper names and foreign subword tokens.

112.description: This feature vector represents Thai character sequences and subwords, particularly those containing the Thai consonant 'ป' (Po Pla) and vowel combinations, along with a few English words.

120.description: This vector activates on foreign-language characters, multilingual subwords, and diverse linguistic script fragments.

40.description: This vector represents characters, subwords, and abbreviations commonly found in Southeast Asian scripts, particularly Thai, mixed with Latin characters and linguistic prefixes.

21.description: This feature vector activates strongly on the letter 'd' and its phonetic equivalents across multiple languages and scripts.
